title: REQ · Claude adapter accepts only structured input and rejects an empty work directory
summary: Prompt is a constant pointing at development/tasks and Run validates workDir before executing
description: Context: claudePrompt is a constant but Run does not validate workDir. Desired behavior: Run returns an error containing 'work dir' when workDir is empty or whitespace, without calling Exec; the prompt arg remains exactly claudePrompt. Expected result: no caller-controlled text can enter the command line and the CLI never runs in an unspecified directory. Why: untrusted-input and workspace isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Given workDir is empty, when Run is called, then it returns an error mentioning work dir and Exec is not called
Given a valid workDir, when Run is called, then the argument after -p equals the fixed prompt and the args contain no workDir text
technical_constraints: No new Run parameters; Agent interface unchanged
